Subject: Ledger sync: weekly submission window + close orchestration

Morning team —

Quick reminder: our weekly submission window for the ledger-refresh closes EOD Friday (04/23). I attached the latest pipeline snapshot and a proposed agenda for the call. High level asks before the sync: 

- Sales owners: please update stage flags (Commit/Commit at Risk/Forecast) and confirm expected close dates in the spreadsheet.
- Finance: flag any deals with revenue recognition questions so we can table them for the close-review slot.
- Procurement (Acme): please confirm whether the SOW redline from last week will be accepted ahead of close.

Proposed 30-min cadence tomorrow at 10:00 PT:
1) Quick lane read (5m) — owners call out risks
2) Commit confirmations (10m) — lock yellow->green/green->red decisions
3) Blockers & procurement status (10m) — external input
4) Action log & next steps (5m)

If anyone needs the slot moved, say so now. Otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite and the dial-in.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- 2027Q2_pipeline_ledger_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
- close-orchestration_agenda_v1.md (text, 3KB)
